children: Centerspace entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Independence Realty Trust in an all-stock transaction. Each Centerspace share will convert into 3.8 shares of Independence Realty common stock, with cash in lieu of fractional shares. The plan includes a follow-on partnership merger, preferred unit exchanges into new IROP preferred units, and adding two Centerspace trustees to Independence Realty’s board at closing. The deal is subject to shareholder approvals, regulatory clearances, NYSE listing, tax opinions, and includes reciprocal termination fees of $45 million (Centerspace) and $60 million (Independence Realty).
